Prior for the TVP-VAR (Primiceri training-sample calibration)

Source: R/tvp.R
tvp_prior.Rd

Hyperparameters of the training-sample prior of Primiceri (2005). Let \(\hat B,\hat\alpha,\hat\sigma\) be OLS estimates on the first tau observations (after lag loss), with covariance matrices \(V(\hat B), V(\hat\alpha)\). Then $$\beta_0\sim N(\hat B,\, c\,V(\hat B)),\quad \alpha_0\sim N(\hat\alpha,\, c\,V(\hat\alpha)),\quad \log\sigma_{i0}\sim N(\log\hat\sigma_i, 10),$$ $$Q\sim IW(k_Q^2\,\nu_Q\,V(\hat B),\nu_Q),\quad S_i\sim IW(k_S^2\,(1+\dim S_i)\,V(\hat\alpha_i),1+\dim S_i),\quad W_i\sim IG(1, k_W^2).$$ The k multipliers are the prior standard deviations of the per-period drift relative to the OLS standard errors; they are the single most influential choice in a TVP-VAR.

Usage

tvp_prior(
  tau = 40L,
  kQ = 0.01,
  kS = 0.1,
  kW = 0.01,
  vscale = 4,
  df_Q = NULL,
  h_var = 10
)

Arguments

tau

training-sample length (effective observations, i.e. after the first p).

kQ, kS, kW

prior scale multipliers for the innovations of the coefficients, of the contemporaneous (A) elements and of the log-volatilities.

vscale

multiplier c on the OLS covariance in the prior for the initial states.

df_Q

prior degrees of freedom of Q (default tau).

h_var

prior variance of the initial log-variance (default 10).

Value

a tvp_prior object for tvpvar().

Details

Economic intuition and pitfalls. kQ encodes how fast the transmission mechanism (lag coefficients) is believed to move. With kQ = 0.01 the prior says a coefficient drifts by about 1% of its OLS standard error per quarter: over 170 quarters that is a standard deviation of roughly 13% of the standard error times \(\sqrt{170}\), so substantial but gradual change is allowed. Raising kQ lets the data attribute any misfit (outliers, omitted variables, mis-specified lags) to coefficient drift, i.e. spurious time variation. The prior is not neutral: with an inverse-Wishart prior whose degrees of freedom are tied to a short training sample, the posterior of Q is dominated by the prior in samples of typical macro length. Always report results for several kQ values and compare with the constant-coefficient fit.

See also

Other TVP-VAR: irf_path(), tidy.tvpvar(), tvp_dynamics, tvp_volatility(), tvpvar()
